title: Cliopatria dated historical polity outlines
attribution: Historical polity outlines: Bennett et al. (2025), Cliopatria, Seshat Global History Databank, v0.2.1, CC BY 4.0. Filtered and encoded as TopoJSON; source dates and names retained.
citation: Bennett, J. S. et al. (2025). Cliopatria — A geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400BCE to 2024CE. Scientific Data 12, 247. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9.
filter: original ToYear >= 1600; no source intervals changed
recordId: clio- plus first 16 hex chars of SHA256 of sorted compact original feature JSON; record-specific, not polity-wide
transformations: Normalize property names, retain all source metadata; add source id and stable record hash
Build shared-arc TopoJSON using mapshaper; no simplification
Quantize using 36000001 grid intervals; output grid longitude 0.00000973156 degrees, latitude 0.00000387670 degrees (<1.1m spacing at equator)
qualityNotes: Sampled historical reconstructions, not verified exact annual sovereign borders
Some source intervals hold earlier sampled shapes or lag accepted dynasty dates
Missing polygons mean unrecorded, not necessarily stateless
Source describes approximately 40km2 equatorial pixel resolution and variable region/time coverage
Parent composites and relation features overlap constituents; default display excludes those parents
Does not contain comprehensive Iranian, Ottoman, or Mughal historical administrative provinces
historicalProvinceCoverage: Not bundled; import sourced, dated GeoJSON or trace research layers with attribution and uncertainty.
